reason: The unit economics are unreasonable; charging ₹99 for just 100g is nearly three times what established brands charge per gram.
objection: ₹99 for 100g feels steep when a 200g pouch of Mother's Recipe is ₹70 and 500g Maggi is ₹72
would_change_my_mind: A 250g value squeeze pack priced around ₹120 on Zepto or Blinkit.
